messages.text:
The metal rack refund proposal is for **BRL 119.00**. Shipping isn’t included in an item refund, and I can’t label it as the item’s price. Confirm the proposal using the button on its card; the shop refunds only the amount paid for the item, excluding shipping (refund-policy/v2/amount).

Since you asked for the delivery charge to be refunded, a staff member must review that request. Would you like a staff member to review the shipping charge? (refund-policy/v2/shipping)
